entries.boundary: The exact permanent homology dimension uses the published beta_2,4 formula for the apolar algebra. The common-factor rank formula is proved from coupled derivative-space isolation and explicit pairwise image intersections. The six-term example rejects only monotone upper-bound comparisons based on scalar homology dimension; it does not rule out exact-value, multigraded, representation-theoretic, or quotient-coupled homology obstructions.
entries.common_factor_result: six-term common-factor family defeats scalar homology upper-bound comparisons
entries.name: second-Koszul homology beta_(2,4)
